title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Signing Deadline and Charges Posted at Signing
content:
**Article 1 — Signing deadline.** The purchase agreement of an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements may be signed only while the hold is in effect. The agreement is signed no later than the hold expiration date recorded on the order. The last day on which the agreement may be signed is the hold expiration date itself, counted as a calendar date; no grace day follows it (the grace allowed is 0 days).

| Signing date | In time |
|---|---|
| Before the hold expiration date | yes |
| On the hold expiration date | yes |
| The day after the hold expiration date | no |

**Article 2 — Charges at signing.** At signing the following charges post to the order, each as its own entry dated the signing date:
- the vehicle price;
- the documentation fee — the former basis for its amount, "the documentation fee for the selling dealer state from the program's documentation fee table", is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current documentation fee basis;
- the sales tax stated on the signed agreement;
- when the transfer distance exceeds the program's free transfer distance, a shipping fee — the former basis for its amount, "a shipping fee equal to the distance-band fee for the full transfer distance reduced by the program's shipping fee discount, rounded to the cent (for an exchange replacement order whose program waives the exchange shipping fee, no shipping fee posts)", is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current shipping fee basis.

**Article 3 — Status for charges.** Agreement charges post only on an order whose status is contracted, and return charges post only on an order whose status is return pending or returned.

**Article 4 — Deposit at signing.** The whole held deposit is applied to the order on the signing date. A deposit is applied only on an order whose status is contracted or cancelled.

**Article 5 — Prices fixed at signing.** Prices and fees are those of the signing date; a later listing price change does not alter a signed agreement.

**Distance-band schedule.** The distance bands of Kestrel's vehicle transfer schedule and their band fees are:

| Transfer distance | Band fee |
|---|---|
| 1 to 500 miles | $499.00 |
| 501 to 1000 miles | $799.00 |
| 1001 to 1500 miles | $1099.00 |
| 1501 miles and above, no upper limit | $1490.00 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle listed at $28900.00 is reserved with a hold expiration date of day 5, and the listing price is lowered to $27900.00 on day 6. An agreement signed on day 5 posts the vehicle price of $28900.00 dated day 5 and applies the whole held deposit that day; the later listing change does not alter it.

superseded_clauses: a shipping fee equal to the distance-band fee for the full transfer distance reduced by the program's shipping fee discount, rounded to the cent (for an exchange replacement order whose program waives the exchange shipping fee, no shipping fee posts)
the documentation fee for the selling dealer state from the program's documentation fee table
